capabilities: Fold all but the cursor's top-level section to focus on one section
Expand the cursor's heading branch and collapse all other branches
Reapply the active fold mode as the cursor moves or the note is edited
Restore earlier fold states or unfold all headings when a mode stops
Show the active pane's mode in the status bar
extras: Manual installation from GitHub releases; not yet listed in the community directory. Uses mobile-compatible APIs but live testing currently covers desktop only; modes do not persist across app restarts. Runs offline with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian's heading folds are set manually and don't follow the cursor, so heading context is lost while moving through long notes.

relations.evidence: Native Obsidian folds are used, including compatibility with the Synchronise Outline Folds plugin.

summary: Heading folding tool that keeps the cursor's heading section expanded while other sections stay folded, in two modes.
